WITH target_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
),
store_sales_1998_base AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN target_dates td
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     AND td.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
store_sales_1999_base AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN target_dates td
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     AND td.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_sales_1998_base AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN target_dates td
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     AND td.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
web_sales_1999_base AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN target_dates td
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
     AND td.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
store_sales_1998_cust AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c.c_login AS customer_login,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           SUM(sb.year_total) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales_1998_base sb ON c.c_customer_sk = sb.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id,
             c.c_first_name,
             c.c_last_name,
             c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
             c.c_birth_country,
             c.c_login,
             c.c_email_address
),
store_sales_1999_cust AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c.c_login AS customer_login,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           SUM(sb.year_total) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales_1999_base sb ON c.c_customer_sk = sb.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id,
             c.c_first_name,
             c.c_last_name,
             c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
             c.c_birth_country,
             c.c_login,
             c.c_email_address
),
web_sales_1998_cust AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c.c_login AS customer_login,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           SUM(sb.year_total) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales_1998_base sb ON c.c_customer_sk = sb.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id,
             c.c_first_name,
             c.c_last_name,
             c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
             c.c_birth_country,
             c.c_login,
             c.c_email_address
),
web_sales_1999_cust AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
           c.c_login AS customer_login,
           c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
           SUM(sb.year_total) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales_1999_base sb ON c.c_customer_sk = sb.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id,
             c.c_first_name,
             c.c_last_name,
             c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
             c.c_birth_country,
             c.c_login,
             c.c_email_address
),
store_pair AS (
    SELECT s99.customer_id,
           s99.customer_first_name,
           s99.customer_last_name,
           s99.customer_email_address,
           s99.year_total / NULLIF(s98.year_total, 0) AS store_ratio
    FROM store_sales_1998_cust s98
    JOIN store_sales_1999_cust s99
      ON s98.customer_id = s99.customer_id
    WHERE s98.year_total > 0
),
web_pair AS (
    SELECT w98.customer_id,
           w99.year_total / NULLIF(w98.year_total, 0) AS web_ratio
    FROM web_sales_1998_cust w98
    JOIN web_sales_1999_cust w99
      ON w98.customer_id = w99.customer_id
    WHERE w98.year_total > 0
)
SELECT sp.customer_id,
       sp.customer_first_name,
       sp.customer_last_name,
       sp.customer_email_address
FROM store_pair sp
JOIN web_pair wp
  ON sp.customer_id = wp.customer_id
WHERE wp.web_ratio > sp.store_ratio
ORDER BY sp.customer_id,
         sp.customer_first_name,
         sp.customer_last_name,
         sp.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
